id: \rOh, a young Trainer. Here's some advice. Status moves may not deal damage, but they can allow you to do more later.
en: \rOh, a young Trainer. Here's some advice. Status moves may not deal damage, but they can allow you to do more later.
it: \rOh, un giovane Allenatore. Ecco un consiglio: le mosse di stato non infliggeranno danni, ma possono permetterti di fare di più in seguito.

id: \bScraggy likes flowers a little too much...
en: \bScraggy likes flowers a little too much...
it: \bScraggy ama un po' troppo i fiori...

id: \bI only have five team members. How was I supposed to know you needed six for some of the battles?!
en: \bI only have five team members. How was I supposed to know you needed six for some of the battles?!
it: \bHo solo cinque membri in squadra. Come facevo a sapere che per alcune lotte ne servivano sei?!

id: \bCilan: \PN. There you are. I saw how wonderful you did in your battles. The spices you threw into the fray were amazing to watch.
en: \bCilan: \PN. There you are. I saw how wonderful you did in your battles. The spices you threw into the fray were amazing to watch.
it: \bSpighetto: \PN, eccoti qua. Ho visto quanto sei stato magnifico nelle tue lotte. Le spezie che hai aggiunto alla mischia sono state uno spettacolo meraviglioso.

id: \bI actually came with a message, but I would be honored if you would battle me first. I need to experience what you showed out there.
en: \bI actually came with a message, but I would be honored if you would battle me first. I need to experience what you showed out there.
it: \bA dire il vero sono venuto a portarti un messaggio, ma sarei onorato se prima lottassi con me. Devo provare di persona ciò che hai mostrato là fuori.

id: \bCilan: Thank you very much for that display. Now on to my message.
en: \bCilan: Thank you very much for that display. Now on to my message.
it: \bSpighetto: Grazie mille per questa dimostrazione. E ora passiamo al messaggio.

id: \bProfessor Juniper would like to see you. She has a challenge for you that might be worth the look.
en: \bProfessor Juniper would like to see you. She has a challenge for you that might be worth the look.
it: \bLa Professoressa Aralia vorrebbe vederti. Ha una sfida per te che potrebbe valere la pena di considerare.

id: \bI've also brought you a gift. The ultimate rod in fishing. With it you'll be able to capture stronger leveled Pokémon with ease.
en: \bI've also brought you a gift. The ultimate rod in fishing. With it you'll be able to capture stronger leveled Pokémon with ease.
it: \bTi ho portato anche un regalo: l'amo definitivo per la pesca. Con questo potrai catturare con facilità Pokémon di livello più alto.

id: \bCilan: Go see Professor Juniper. She has something for you.
en: \bCilan: Go see Professor Juniper. She has something for you.
it: \bSpighetto: Va' dalla Professoressa Aralia. Ha qualcosa per te.

id: \bI wonder if I can use my secret weapon?
en: \bI wonder if I can use my secret weapon?
it: \bChissà se posso usare la mia arma segreta?

id: \rThat shop looks... so empty to me. \nWhat do you think?
en: \rThat shop looks... so empty to me. \nWhat do you think?
it: \rQuel negozio mi sembra... così vuoto. \nTu che ne pensi?
